Prior member experience / 2016

Japan Wave Expo.

Japanese fashion meets Indonesian buyers, media and audiences.

At a glance

Organization / context
JETRO-initiated program
Market
Japan → Indonesia · Jakarta
Member
Rinintha Pradiza
Year
2016
Capabilities
Partnerships & Market Access / Live & Activation
16Japanese companies

Project scope

A three-day platform combining business matching, test marketing, fashion showcases and public programming for 16 Japanese companies.

The challenge

Make a fashion-business mission relevant to buyers and consumers in Jakarta, while connecting commercial objectives with a public experience.

Member contribution

Rinintha served as Creative & Delivery Lead: concepts, proposals, client and sponsor relationships, budgets, programming, fashion-show direction, international coordination and venue delivery.

Outcome

The program connected 16 Japanese companies with Indonesian buyers, media and consumers across Central Park and Tribeca Park.

This work predates dot.wave. Project outcomes belong to the wider project and its collaborators; the contribution above identifies the member’s role.
